label: At D2, higher after choosing a2 and when the observer believes S2 is good.
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (in_rew == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_action == 2)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 18 sits near 0.93 at D1, 0.97 at GO and about 0.67 at D2. Beyond timing it varies mostly at D2. There it is higher when the choice just made was a2 (observed at D2) and lower the more the ideal observer believes S1 is good (graded belief_lo, negative weight). A weaker belief_lo effect with the same sign appears at D1. GO barely varies. The free fit (8 terms: a2-to-S2 interaction, previous action at D1, belief at GO, reward terms) adds only about 0.02 dev R^2 over the 3-term short form (0.73 vs 0.71). Remaining misses: D2 after unrewarded a1 trials, and long unrewarded streaks, are lower than predicted. The reached state, this trial s reward and the hidden good state add little once choice and belief are in. Observed-only: no future or model-output variables are used.

issues: The direction of the claims holds: at D2, z is higher after choosing a2 and when the observer believes S2 is good. The profile shows D2 residual +0.15 for a2 vs -0.18 for a1, and belief deciles run from +0.18 (sure S2 is good) to -0.20 (sure S1 is good).

The belief shape is wrong. The D2 effect saturates like the probability, not the log-odds. Swapping (phase == D2) * belief_lo for (phase == D2) * belief raises test R^2 beyond timing from 0.695 to 0.779. The D2 deciles plateau at both ends (0-3 about +0.17, 7-9 about -0.18), which a log-odds term cannot follow.
The fitted weights for D2 a2 (+0.191) and D2 belief (-0.192) come out nearly equal and opposite. So one term, (phase == D2) * ((action == 2) - belief), scores the same (0.779) and frees a slot.

A large systematic error class remains in the recorded short form, and the explanation only half-notes it. Misses show D2 after a1 S1 u over-predicted by 0.119 and D2 after a1 S2 u by 0.099, and the profile residual for D2 after a1 S2 u is -0.283. Adding (phase == D2) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) (weight -0.12) raises test R^2 beyond timing to 0.828, well above the recorded free fit (0.714).

The D1 belief term is small (weight -0.014) and adds only about 0.02. D1 also has an unmodelled pattern: after a1 reached S2 (rare), z is lower by about 0.07-0.09 (residual -0.09 to -0.11) whatever the reward.
The label leaves out the previous-trial effect (a1 then no reward lowers z at D2), which is the largest remaining miss.
